maya: Postmortem follow-up  we saw repeated large blast radii from fast rollouts. Short plan: telemetry handoff + a light auto-contain flow. Owners?

maya: Items: 1) per-flag rollout telemetry (activation hist + burn-rate alert) 2) small pre-ramp probe (1% x 5m) 3) simple containment runbook (quarantine + 0%)

sam: Ill take telemetry. Will add activation hist, traffic split, and a weekly blast KPI. ETA 9d.

nina: I can do pre-ramp probe + CI hook. Default 1% for 5m, rolling 30m baseline. Fail -> hold and page. ETA 7d.

maya: Nina, add low-signal fallback to 24h EWMA. Sam, make sure burn-rate alerts page product owner + oncall.

sam: noted. Also logging every automated containment as an audit event.

nina: adding sample probe config to my PR.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-6000 -> "Per-flag telemetry & blast KPI" (assignee: sam, due: 9d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-6001 -> "Pre-ramp probe + CI hook" (assignee: nina, due: 7d).

maya: Next: owners update tickets with blockers by EOD Wed. Quick check Fri 10:00 in #eng-platform.
